high_level_description: This image is a comparison of Singapore's skyline from the year 2000 and its current state, as presented on an Instagram post by the account `_national_archaeology_`. The post includes two photographs side by side. Top Image (2000): The photograph is in black and white. It shows a view of Singapore's waterfront with a large body of water in the foreground. There are several boats scattered across the water. In the background, there is a cluster of tall buildings, which appear to be part of the city's skyline at that time.
